afterImport: If your daily notes are not at `Daily/<date>.md`, open the **Log book** macro and click the cog on the **logBook** step to set **Daily note path** (the page uses `bins/daily/{{DATE:gggg-MM-DD - ddd MMM D}}.md`). Change **Property name** there too if you log to something other than `Book`.
Run **Log book** from the command palette and type a title; it is written to that property in today's note.
